name: weighted-swiss-ball-wall-squat.html
instructions:
1. Set up for the exercise by choosing a pair of dumbbells and positioning an exercise ball between the center of your back and a wall. It may be ideal to have a training partner hand you the dumbbells once the exercise ball was in place.
2. Stand up straight with a slight bend in your knees and hold the dumbbells down at your sides.
3. Walk your feet out a few steps while keeping your upper body flat against the ball.
4. Your legs should be straight with a slight bend in your knees and your feet should be just inside shoulder width apart. This is the starting position.
5. While bending at the knees and sliding your torso downward (still pressed against the ball) lower your buttocks towards the ground. Keep your core muscles tense to hold the ball in place against the wall.
6. Squat down until your thighs are parallel to the floor.
7. Pause for a moment and press through your heels to push yourself back to the starting position.
8. Repeat this movement for desired reps.
